Академия — отдельное пространство для из:
The Academy is a dedicated space for learning the game.

Choose a course on the home page. Each course includes the basics, practice in ED Copilot and a knowledge check. The left contents panel navigates lessons; the right panel navigates article sections.

Bookmark useful lessons. The application saves bookmarks, completed steps, answers and reading position in your profile. Reading mode hides the main menu so you can focus on the lesson.

The Studied button marks a lesson complete; answering its questions alone does not complete it. Tool buttons open the related Copilot sections.

Lessons are available offline. Links at the end open additional PTN material in your browser. Game mechanics and available operations may change; the final conditions are always shown in the game.
Калькулятор затрат на флотоносец\n\n1. В:
Carrier cost calculator

1. Choose a personal or squadron carrier. Each type keeps its own plan.
2. Set each optional service to active, suspended or not installed. Suspending reduces upkeep but does not free capacity. The squadron carrier's built-in shipyard cannot be removed.
3. Specify planned jumps per week. Jump maintenance and tritium purchases are calculated separately. Fuel estimates remain unknown if average consumption or fuel price is unknown.
4. Enter cargo, bank balance and desired reserve. Select Save settings to update the calculation.
5. Compare the initial purchase, upkeep, free capacity and budget. The 30-day and 365-day periods are proportional estimates, not a schedule of weekly charges.

Use Carrier Route to calculate fuel for a particular journey. Calculator settings do not change in-game services or finances.
